name: transcript
description: Convert AI coding-agent session transcripts between harness formats (WASM).

scripts.setup: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.126 --locked
scripts.build: cargo build --lib --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features wasm && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/transcript.wasm --out-dir pkg --target nodejs
